    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    AddSeasonalItemDialog
    Window for adding a new seasonal menu item together with its recipe.
    AddSeasonalItemDialog.InventoryItemComboWrapper
    An inventory item shown in the ingredient drop-down as its name and ID.
    AppLogger
    Simple console logger used across the application.
    CartItem
    One line in the cashier's current order: a drink with its sugar level, ice level, toppings and quantity.
    CashierView
    Cashier ordering screen.
    DatabaseConfig
    Database connection settings for the application.
    DatabaseManager
    Owns the single shared database connection for the application.
    DatabaseSeeder
    Creates the database tables and loads them from the CSV files in data/.
    Employee
    An employee who can sign in to the POS, matching one row of the employee table.
    EmployeeDAO
    Reads and writes rows in the employee table: signing in with a PIN and adding, editing and removing employees.
    EmployeePanel
    Manager tab for viewing and managing employees.
    HourlyActivityChartPanel
    Bar chart of sales for each hour of one day, drawn with Java 2D.
    InventoryDAO
    Reads and writes rows in the inventory_item table: listing stock, restocking, and adding, editing and removing ingredients.
    InventoryItem
    An ingredient or supply the store keeps in stock, matching one row of the inventory_item table.
    InventoryPanel
    Manager tab for checking and restocking inventory.
    KpiCard
    A small summary card that shows one key number, such as total sales, with a title above it and an optional note below it.
    LoginView
    Terminal lock screen, the first window shown when the app starts.
    Main
    Entry point for the Sharetea POS and inventory management application.
    ManagerView
    Main window for managers in the Sharetea POS system.
    MenuItem
    A drink or topping on the menu, matching one row of the menu_item table.
    MenuItemDAO
    Reads and writes rows in the menu_item and recipe tables: listing drinks and toppings, and adding, editing and removing menu items.
    MenuItemDAO.RecipeEntry
    One ingredient in a new menu item's recipe: which inventory item it uses and how much of it goes into one drink.
    MenuPanel
    Manager tab for viewing and managing the menu.
    OrderDAO
    Saves customer orders placed at the cashier screen.
    ProductUsageChartPanel
    Horizontal bar chart of the ten most-used inventory items, drawn with Java 2D.
    ProductUsagePanel
    Manager panel that shows how much of each inventory item was used during a date range.
    ReportsDAO
    Runs the read-only queries behind the manager reports: trends, top sellers, inventory status, product usage, the X-Report and the sales report.
    ReportsDAO.HourlySalesActivity
    Sales for one hour of a day, used by the X-Report.
    ReportsDAO.InventoryKpis
    Stock summary counts for the inventory panel.
    ReportsDAO.ItemSalesReport
    One row of the sales report: how one menu item sold in a date range.
    ReportsDAO.PaymentMethodSummary
    Sales for one payment method on a day, used by the X-Report.
    ReportsDAO.ProductUsageItem
    How much of one inventory item was used by orders in a date range.
    ReportsDAO.TopSellingItem
    One row of the top-selling drinks list.
    ReportsDAO.TrendsKpis
    Summary numbers for the trends panel over a date range.
    ReportsDAO.XReportData
    Everything shown on the X-Report for one day: sales totals, sales by hour and sales by payment method.
    RevenueChartPanel
    Line chart of daily sales over time, drawn with Java 2D.
    SalesReportPanel
    Manager tab showing how each menu item sold over a date range.
    Theme
    Shared colors, fonts and widget helpers, so every screen has the same plain gray desktop look.
    TrendsPanel
    Manager tab showing sales trends over a date range.
    XReportPanel
    Manager tab for the X-Report: a mid-day register check for one day.
